about: What a restaurant may change in the Larder & Lamp design. Protected: the scroll-run dinner on a table seen from above (place settings, the candle, bread and wine, three courses served and cleared, coffee and the bill), the menu with its filters and the dinner total, the floor plan and its booking logic, the opening hours and the street map, layout, type and all interaction code. The restaurant's own words, dishes and prices, the plates the hero serves, its tables, hours and streets come from the content.
rules: Text may not contain < > { } or line breaks.

stages: the six moments of the dinner the hero serves, in order: seated, bread and drinks, starters, mains, dessert, coffee and the bill; each a short name, a caption naming the restaurant's own dishes, and a clock time.
dishes: the plates the hero serves, two per course (starters, mains, desserts), each drawn as a kind (soup, salad, pasta, fish, meat, veg, bowl, tart, quenelle) in its main colour.

menu.courses: two to five sections (snacks, starters, mains...), each with one to six dishes: name, a short line, price and tags (V vegetarian, VG vegan, GF gluten-free). menu.pairing is a wine pairing per person (0 hides it).
room.seats: seats at each of the plan's nine tables, in order: tables 1, 2, 3 and 7 are round (2-4), 4, 5 and 8 square (2-4), 6 and 9 long (4-8).

visit: opening hours per day (null when closed), the address in two lines, and the map's streets: the street the restaurant is on, the cross street, a side street, water nearby (left out if none) and a walking note.
